digest.component_or_area: MCP server factory and Pydantic settings initialization
propositions: First construction of MCP v1 FastMCP via rebar.mcp_server.build_server() emits IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning because Settings is defined before FastMCP and never rebuilt, leaving the lifespan field as an unresolved ForwardRef.
When IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning is promoted to an error, the public build_server() call fails before server construction completes.
Calling Settings.model_rebuild() at the lazy import boundary in build_server() before FastMCP or HTTP/stdio construction resolves the forward reference and eliminates the warning.
The fix adds no external dependency, preserves optional MCP imports, and produces identical runtime behavior and schema output to the untreated case.
